fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Dynamic Thermal Mass with Combustion & Stack Loss
source: Annamalai & Puri (2007) Combustion Science and Engineering; ASME PTC 4-2013 Fired Steam Generators (heat-loss method); EN 303-1; Babcock & Wilcox 'Steam' (41st ed., 2005)

unit.name: Generic 50 kW No.2 Fuel Oil Boiler — Physics-Lumped Dynamic

Q_rated.note: Rated thermal output (water-side) at full fire

LHV_oil.note: Lower heating value, No.2 fuel oil / light heating oil (Annamalai & Puri 2007, Table)

stoich_afr.note: Stoichiometric air-fuel ratio for No.2 fuel oil (CnH1.8n, ~14.3-14.5)

excess_air_ratio.note: lambda: total air / stoichiometric air (typical oil burner 1.15-1.25)

H_fuel.note: Hydrogen mass fraction in No.2 fuel oil (drives latent stack loss via H2O formation)

cp_flue.note: Mean flue-gas specific heat 20-250C (Babcock & Wilcox Steam; ~1.05 kJ/kgK)

cp_water.note: Liquid water specific heat at ~50C (NIST/IAPWS, 4.18 kJ/kgK)

hfg_water.note: Latent heat of vaporization of water ~25C, for latent stack loss (NIST)

T_flue_full.note: Stack gas temperature at full fire (oil boiler, kept high to avoid sulfur dewpoint)

m_water.note: Lumped water content of boiler shell/jacket

m_metal.note: Boiler metal mass (steel pressure vessel + heat-exchange surface)

cp_metal.note: Carbon steel specific heat (Babcock & Wilcox Steam)
